verdict.rationale: Bevy has no dedicated scripting language or official LSP/typed-API surface of its own; it is consumed via plain Rust, and the evidence only notes that docs.rs/bevy exposes fully static, crawlable typed API docs and a code-first cargo workflow that needs no editor for an agent to drive, with no official MCP or llms.txt present. Missing for 10: explicit mention of rust-analyzer/LSP support for Bevy code, first-party editor tooling or completions/diagnostics guarantees, and any Bevy-specific navigation tooling beyond generic Rust crate docs.
